goal.sl: Ponudiš in obljubiš (I'll carry it, I won't tell anyone), poveš, kaj misliš, da se bo zgodilo (I think it'll rain), vprašaš Will you …? in ponudiš s Shall I …?
goal.de: Du bietest an und versprichst (I'll carry it, I won't tell anyone), sagst, was deiner Meinung nach passiert (I think it'll rain), fragst Will you …? und bietest an mit Shall I …?
goal.it: Offri e prometti (I'll carry it, I won't tell anyone), dici che cosa pensi che succederà (I think it'll rain), chiedi Will you …? e offri con Shall I …?
goal.en: You can offer and promise (I'll carry it, I won't tell anyone), say what you think will happen (I think it'll rain), ask Will you …? and offer with Shall I …?

say.sl: **will** (kratko **'ll**) + osnovna oblika, za vse enako, za to, kar se odločiš med govorjenjem, in za ponudbe: **That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.** (Ta torba je težka, jaz jo nesem.) **The phone's ringing. I'll get it.** (Telefon zvoni, se jaz oglasim.) **We'll help you.** (Ti pomagamo.) Slovenščina tu reče sedanjik, angleščina nikoli *I carry it*. Brez -s: **she'll come**.
say.de: **will** (kurz **'ll**) + Grundform, für alle gleich, für das, was du beim Sprechen beschließt, und für Angebote: **That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.** (Die Tasche ist schwer, ich trage sie.) **The phone's ringing. I'll get it.** (Das Telefon läutet, ich gehe ran.) Nie *I carry it*. Kein -s: **she'll come**. Vorsicht: **I will** heißt nicht *ich will*, das ist **I want**.
say.it: **will** (breve **'ll**) + la forma base, uguale per tutti, per ciò che decidi mentre parli e per le offerte: **That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.** (Quella borsa è pesante, la porto io.) **The phone's ringing. I'll get it.** (Suona il telefono, rispondo io.) **We'll help you.** (Ti aiutiamo noi.) Mai *I carry it*. Senza -s: **she'll come**.
say.en: **will** (short **'ll**) + the base form, the same for everyone, for what you decide as you speak, and for offers: **That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.** (never *I carry it.*) **The phone's ringing. I'll get it.** **We'll help you.** No -s: **she'll come** (never *she'll comes*).

say.sl: Tudi obljuba vzame **will**, zanikano je **won't** (will not): **I'll be back by six, I promise.** (Do šestih bom nazaj, obljubim.) **I won't tell anyone.** (Nikomur ne bom povedal{m:|f:a}.) **Don't worry, we won't be late.** (Brez skrbi, ne bomo zamudili.) Za vse enako: **Meg won't bite.** (Meg ne bo ugriznila.)
say.de: Auch ein Versprechen nimmt **will**, verneint heißt es **won't** (will not): **I'll be back by six, I promise.** (Bis sechs bin ich zurück, versprochen.) **I won't tell anyone.** (Ich sage es niemandem.) **Don't worry, we won't be late.** (Keine Sorge, wir kommen nicht zu spät.) Für alle gleich: **Meg won't bite.** (Meg beißt nicht.)
say.it: Anche una promessa vuole **will**, e il no è **won't** (will not): **I'll be back by six, I promise.** (Alle sei sono di ritorno, te lo prometto.) **I won't tell anyone.** (Non lo dico a nessuno.) **Don't worry, we won't be late.** (Non preoccuparti, non faremo tardi.) Uguale per tutti: **Meg won't bite.** (Meg non morde.)
say.en: A promise takes **will** too, and no is **won't** (will not): **I'll be back by six, I promise.** **I won't tell anyone.** **Don't worry, we won't be late.** It is the same for everyone: **Meg won't bite.**

say.sl: **will** pove tudi, kar misliš, da se bo zgodilo: **It'll rain tomorrow.** (Jutri bo deževalo.) **I think Jack will win.** (Mislim, da bo Jack zmagal.) **Sam will probably be late.** (Sam bo verjetno zamudil.) Gre z **I think** (mislim), **I'm sure** (prepričan{m:|f:a} sem), **probably** (verjetno), **maybe** (mogoče). Zanikano: **He won't come.** (Ne bo prišel.) ali **I don't think he'll come.** (Mislim, da ne bo prišel.)
say.de: **will** sagt auch, was deiner Meinung nach passieren wird: **It'll rain tomorrow.** (Morgen regnet es.) **I think Jack will win.** (Ich glaube, Jack gewinnt.) **Sam will probably be late.** (Sam kommt wahrscheinlich zu spät.) Es passt zu **I think** (ich glaube), **I'm sure** (ich bin sicher), **probably** (wahrscheinlich), **maybe** (vielleicht). Verneint: **He won't come.** (Er kommt nicht.) oder **I don't think he'll come.** (Ich glaube nicht, dass er kommt.)
say.it: **will** dice anche ciò che pensi che succederà: **It'll rain tomorrow.** (Domani pioverà.) **I think Jack will win.** (Credo che vincerà Jack.) **Sam will probably be late.** (Sam farà probabilmente tardi.) Va con **I think** (credo), **I'm sure** (sono sicur{m:o|f:a}), **probably** (probabilmente), **maybe** (forse). Il no: **He won't come.** (Non verrà.) o **I don't think he'll come.** (Non credo che verrà.)
say.en: **will** also says what you think will happen: **It'll rain tomorrow.** **I think Jack will win.** **Sam will probably be late.** It goes with **I think**, **I'm sure**, **probably**, **maybe**. For no: **He won't come.** or **I don't think he'll come.**

examples.de: Morgen regnet es.

say.sl: Pri vprašanju gre **will** naprej: **Will you be at home tonight?** (Boš nocoj doma?) **Will it be cold?** (Bo mraz?) **Will you help me?** (Mi boš pomagal{m:|f:a}?) Kratki odgovor ima **will**: **Yes, I will.** (Ja.) **No, I won't.** (Ne.) Nikoli *Yes, I'll*.
say.de: Bei der Frage kommt **will** nach vorn: **Will you be at home tonight?** (Bist du heute Abend zu Hause?) **Will it be cold?** (Wird es kalt?) **Will you help me?** (Hilfst du mir?) Die Kurzantwort behält **will**: **Yes, I will.** (Ja.) **No, I won't.** (Nein.) Nie *Yes, I'll*.
say.it: Per chiedere, **will** va all'inizio: **Will you be at home tonight?** (Stasera sei a casa?) **Will it be cold?** (Farà freddo?) **Will you help me?** (Mi aiuti?) La risposta breve tiene **will**: **Yes, I will.** (Sì.) **No, I won't.** (No.) Mai *Yes, I'll*.
say.en: To ask, **will** goes first: **Will you be at home tonight?** **Will it be cold?** **Will you help me?** The short answer keeps **will**: **Yes, I will.** (never *Yes, I'll.*) **No, I won't.**

say.sl: Ko ponudiš ali predlagaš, britanska angleščina vpraša s **shall**, samo pri **I** in **we**: **Shall I open the window?** (Naj odprem okno?) **Shall we go?** (Gremo?) **What shall we do?** (Kaj naj naredimo?) Odgovor: **Yes, please.** (Ja, prosim.) **No, thanks.** (Ne, hvala.) Ameriško **Should I …?** je tudi prav.
say.de: Beim Anbieten und Vorschlagen fragt das britische Englisch mit **shall**, nur bei **I** und **we**: **Shall I open the window?** (Soll ich das Fenster aufmachen?) **Shall we go?** (Gehen wir?) **What shall we do?** (Was machen wir?) Die Antwort: **Yes, please.** (Ja, bitte.) **No, thanks.** (Nein, danke.) Amerikanisch **Should I …?** ist auch richtig.
say.it: Per offrire o proporre, l'inglese britannico chiede con **shall**, solo con **I** e **we**: **Shall I open the window?** (Apro la finestra?) **Shall we go?** (Andiamo?) **What shall we do?** (Che cosa facciamo?) La risposta: **Yes, please.** (Sì, grazie.) **No, thanks.** (No, grazie.) Anche l'americano **Should I …?** va bene.
say.en: To offer or suggest, British English asks with **shall**, only with **I** and **we**: **Shall I open the window?** **Shall we go?** **What shall we do?** The answer: **Yes, please.** **No, thanks.** The American **Should I …?** is right too.

say.sl: **will** ali **going to**? Odločeno prav zdaj: **We've got no milk. — I'll get some.** (Nimamo mleka, grem ponj.) Odločeno že prej: **I know. I'm going to get some later.** (Vem, kasneje ga grem kupit.) Kar misliš: **I think it'll rain.** (Mislim, da bo deževalo.) Kar vidiš: **Look! It's going to rain.** (Poglej, deževalo bo.)
say.de: **will** oder **going to**? Gerade beschlossen: **We've got no milk. — I'll get some.** (Wir haben keine Milch, ich hole welche.) Schon vorher beschlossen: **I know. I'm going to get some later.** (Ich weiß, ich hole später welche.) Was du glaubst: **I think it'll rain.** (Ich glaube, es regnet.) Was du siehst: **Look! It's going to rain.** (Schau, gleich regnet es.)
say.it: **will** o **going to**? Deciso adesso: **We've got no milk. — I'll get some.** (Non c'è latte, vado a prenderlo io.) Già deciso prima: **I know. I'm going to get some later.** (Lo so, vado a prenderlo più tardi.) Ciò che pensi: **I think it'll rain.** (Credo che pioverà.) Ciò che vedi: **Look! It's going to rain.** (Guarda, sta per piovere.)
say.en: **will** or **going to**? Decided just now: **We've got no milk. — I'll get some.** Decided before: **I know. I'm going to get some later.** What you think: **I think it'll rain.** What you can see: **Look! It's going to rain.**

title.it: Una mattina di pioggia alla locanda
title.en: A wet morning at the inn

exercises.text: — It's raining and the walkers haven't got coats. — Don't worry, Mrs Birkett. ___ (I) take them to the bus in the van. — Thank you, Sam! ___ you be back for lunch? — Yes, I ___. I ___ (not) be late, I promise. — ___ I make you some sandwiches? — Yes, please! — I think it ___ stop raining by two, but the fells ___ (not) be dry for days.

translation.sl: Dežuje, pohodniki pa nimajo plaščev. — Brez skrbi, gospa Birkett. Jaz jih peljem s kombijem na avtobus. — Hvala, Sam! Boš nazaj za kosilo? — Ja. Ne bom zamudil, obljubim. — Naj ti naredim nekaj sendvičev? — Ja, prosim! — Mislim, da bo do dveh nehalo deževati, ampak hribi še dolgo ne bodo suhi.
translation.de: Es regnet, und die Wanderer haben keine Mäntel. — Keine Sorge, Mrs Birkett. Ich bringe sie mit dem Lieferwagen zum Bus. — Danke, Sam! Bist du zum Mittagessen zurück? — Ja. Ich komme nicht zu spät, versprochen. — Soll ich dir ein paar Sandwiches machen? — Ja, bitte! — Ich glaube, bis zwei hört es auf zu regnen, aber die Berge bleiben noch tagelang nass.
translation.it: Piove e gli escursionisti non hanno il cappotto. — Non si preoccupi, Mrs Birkett. Li porto io all'autobus con il furgone. — Grazie, Sam! Torni per pranzo? — Sì. Non farò tardi, lo prometto. — Ti preparo qualche panino? — Sì, grazie! — Credo che smetterà di piovere entro le due, ma i monti resteranno bagnati per giorni.
translation.en: It's raining and the walkers haven't got coats. — Don't worry, Mrs Birkett. I'll take them to the bus in the van. — Thank you, Sam! Will you be back for lunch? — Yes, I will. I won't be late, I promise. — Shall I make you some sandwiches? — Yes, please! — I think it will stop raining by two, but the fells won't be dry for days.

translation.sl: Mislim, da bo nocoj snežilo. — Potem bom pripeljal ovce s hriba. — Naj ti pomagam, Jack? — Ne, hvala. Z Meg ne bova dolgo. Do šestih bova nazaj, gospa Birkett pa bo imela juho za naju.
translation.de: Ich glaube, heute Nacht schneit es. — Dann hole ich die Schafe vom Berg. — Soll ich dir helfen, Jack? — Nein, danke. Meg und ich brauchen nicht lang. Bis sechs sind wir zurück, und Mrs Birkett hat Suppe für uns.
translation.it: Credo che stanotte nevicherà. — Allora porto giù le pecore dal monte. — Ti aiuto, Jack? — No, grazie. Io e Meg non ci mettiamo molto. Alle sei siamo di ritorno e Mrs Birkett avrà la zuppa per noi.
translation.en: I think it will snow tonight. — Then I'll bring the sheep down from the fell. — Shall I help you, Jack? — No, thanks. Meg and I won't be long. We'll be back by six, and Mrs Birkett will have soup for us.
